name: 天赋与成长
intro: 回答「一个人凭什么变强」。天赋是先天的（气质、异相、血统），决定上限与方向；成长途径是后天的，决定怎么爬金属位阶。全部取自欧洲民俗与制度：体液气质、民间相信的「天生异相」、学徒制、誓言、契约、功业、圣物传承。

subgroups.name: 天赋与气质
subgroups.intro: 西方民间从不讲「灵根」，而讲气质（temperament）和「天生的记号」。

entries.name: 天赋之火
entries.summary: 先天力量的强弱：无火 Giftless（终生难以觉醒）→ 微火 Ember → 明火 Flame → 烈火 Blaze → 天火 Wildfire（百年一遇，觉醒即暴走）。决定升阶速度与上限，不决定当前位阶。

xianxia.note: 差异：只表强弱，不表属性（属性由气质决定）；且西方叙事更重「天赋不足靠意志与誓言弥补」。

details.Giftless 无火: 约九成人；勇武与工艺路线仍可走
details.Wildfire 天火: 上限未知，失控风险极高

entries.visual: 试金石上划出的痕迹亮度（见试金石 IT22）。

references.note: 先天强度上限，训练只能逼近

image.brief: Five identical old iron lanterns with glass panes in a row on a dark stone shelf, left to right: the first completely dark and cold, the second with a tiny dim ember, the third with a steady candle flame, the fourth with a bright roaring blaze, and the fifth with a wild blinding white fire so strong it is cracking its glass panes.

entries.name: 四种气质
entries.summary: 按中世纪体液说，每个人生来偏于一种气质，对应一种元素亲和：多血质 Sanguine—风，胆汁质 Choleric—火，抑郁质 Melancholic—土，黏液质 Phlegmatic—水。气质同时决定性格与擅长的魔法。

xianxia.note: 差异：西方气质同时是性格学——火系的人易怒、水系的人沉静，性格与能力天然一致。

details.Sanguine 多血质: 风 · 春 · 乐观好动，擅风系、惑控
details.Choleric 胆汁质: 火 · 夏 · 果断易怒，擅火系、勇武
details.Melancholic 抑郁质: 土 · 秋 · 深思敏感，擅土系、预言、死灵
details.Phlegmatic 黏液质: 水 · 冬 · 冷静温和，擅水系、治愈、防护
details.均衡者: 四液平衡者罕见，可修全部元素但都难精

entries.visual: 气质决定灵魂光泽之外的「底色」：风浅蓝、火赤、土褐、水青。

references.work: 希波克拉底—盖伦体液说
references.note: 四体液对应四元素、四季

image.brief: Four allegorical adult figures standing in a row, each embodying one temperament and its element: a cheerful young person in light blue with wind blowing their hair and birds around them (air), a fierce warrior in red with flames rising behind them (fire), a pensive scholar in brown and black with a book and stones at their feet (earth), and a calm serene figure in sea-green robes with flowing water around their feet (water).

entries.name: 第七子之七子
entries.name_en: Seventh Son of a Seventh Son
entries.summary: 民间相信第七子的第七子能以触摸治病，尤其是瘰疬（「国王之疾」），爱尔兰传统还说他们能预言。本库定为罕见天赋：圣光与驱邪亲和极高，并且（本库设定）女巫与恶魔无法对其隐藏身份。

xianxia.concept: 天生道体 / 特殊体质（参照）

details.效果: 天生的治愈之手、识破伪装与附身
details.代价: 被恶魔与女巫视为头号威胁

entries.visual: 无外在记号；触碰病人时手掌微热发光。

references.work: Lupton《千件奇事》（1660）与法国 Marcou 传统

references.note: 第七子与国王触摸治瘰疬

image.brief: An adult man in plain undyed wool clothes of a village healer, a simple leather satchel of herbs, gentle tired eyes, his open hands slightly raised and glowing with a faint warm golden light from the palms, a calm and humble expression.

entries.name: 胎膜之子
entries.summary: 出生时头上覆着羊膜的人。欧洲民间普遍相信胎膜能防溺死，水手会买来作护身符；意大利弗留利的 benandanti 传统说胎膜之子夜里灵魂出窍、与巫师作战。本库定为：天生的通灵与预言天赋，常在梦中看见未来。

xianxia.concept: 天生灵眼 / 阴阳眼（参照）

details.效果: 看见亡魂与妖精、预知梦、水中不溺
details.代价: 常被亡魂纠缠，难以分清梦与现实

entries.visual: 灰色雾状的瞳孔边缘，看灵体时瞳孔蒙上一层薄膜般的光。

references.work: Britannica 与狄更斯《大卫·科波菲尔》
Carlo Ginzburg 研究的弗留利 benandanti
references.note: 胎膜之子出魂与巫师作战

image.brief: Backdrop: plain soft grey. A pale adult woman with a dark shawl draped loosely over her hair, ordinary round human ears; around the grey iris of each eye a clearly visible soft ring of glowing pale grey mist slowly swirls, like fog curling around the iris, unmistakable at a glance; a small silver locket at her throat; faint translucent ghostly faces barely visible in the air behind her shoulders; quiet, haunted expression.

entries.name: 女巫印记
entries.summary: 历史上的「女巫印记」（devil's mark）是猎巫者声称魔鬼立约时留下的记号，多在隐秘处、针刺不痛。本库改编为：女巫血统的天生胎记，标志着巫术天赋，也是被猎杀的理由。

xianxia.note: 史料中是立约后的记号而非胎记；「天生胎记」是本库设定。

details.效果: 巫术与诅咒亲和、能与使魔缔约

entries.visual: 新月或星形的暗红胎记，施法时微微发烫发光。

references.work: 詹姆斯六世《恶魔学》（1597）与霍普金斯《发现女巫》（1647）
references.note: devil's mark：立约记号、针刺不痛

image.brief: Close-up concept of a human shoulder blade and upper back of a figure shown from behind, skin lit softly, with a distinct dark red crescent-moon-shaped birthmark that glows faintly from within with warm ember light, a few strands of dark hair falling over it, dark charcoal background. Tasteful, intimate, mysterious.

entries.name: 光痕
entries.summary: 身上无故出现的发光烙痕，形状如本库的七芒太阳盘，被视为「光」的选民。本库定为：圣光天赋的最高记号，能直接施展神迹，但每次施展烙痕都会灼痛渗血。

xianxia.note: 取「圣痕」的结构（神选的身体记号），形状与位置原创，不模仿真实宗教的受难伤痕。

details.代价: 每次施展都会流血；被教会控制或供奉

entries.visual: 锁骨下方一枚七芒形的烙痕，施展时透出金光。

references.work: 欧洲圣徒传说（只借结构）
references.note: 身体记号作为神选标志

image.brief: Close-up of a person's bare shoulder and collarbone area against a dark charcoal background, skin lit softly, with a small raised scar-like brand in the shape of a seven-rayed sun disc just below the collarbone, glowing from within with soft golden light that seeps out in thin rays, faint gold motes rising. Reverent, painful, sacred.

entries.name: 换生儿
entries.summary: 被妖精偷换到人类摇篮里的孩子（或被换走后又回来的孩子）。外表是人，但血里有妖精：天生的幻术、对铁的不适、说不了谎。

xianxia.concept: 妖胎 / 被调包的仙裔（参照）

details.效果: 幻魅亲和、看见妖精、聆听动物
details.代价: 冷铁灼伤；妖精宫廷随时可能来「讨回」

entries.visual: 过于明亮或颜色怪异的眼睛、耳尖微尖。

image.brief: Backdrop: plain soft warm grey. An adult changeling who looks almost entirely human: wild tangled hair completely covering both ears, with only one tiny slightly pointed ear tip barely peeking through the hair; natural green eyes just a little too bright; faint freckles that glimmer slightly; a sprig of rowan tucked in a plain linen collar; an uncanny, wistful smile.

entries.name: 冷铁之魂
entries.summary: 完全无法施法、也几乎不受魔法影响的人：法术打在身上会熄灭，护盾一碰就碎。被魔法社会视为残缺，却是一切法师的天敌。

xianxia.concept: 废灵根 / 绝灵体（参照）
xianxia.note: 差异：西方民俗中冷铁破除魔法，本库把它做成一种人的灵魂特质。

details.效果: 抗魔、触碰可驱散法术与幻象
details.代价: 无法被治疗魔法救治、无法使用魔法物品
details.位阶: 不在金属位阶内；以勇武路线成长

entries.visual: 力量爆发时周围的魔法光像被风吹灭的烛火。

references.note: cold iron 克制妖精与魔法

image.brief: A hooded figure stands calmly holding up one open hand with five clearly separated fingers as a bright violet fireball strikes the palm and disintegrates into dull grey ash; at the same moment the small invented glowing glyphs floating in the dark space around them (little shapes of leaves, flames and waves) are going out like candles in a gust of wind, the nearest ones already dark and trailing thin smoke; the figure itself has no glow. Stark, quiet, unsettling.

entries.name: 预言之子
entries.summary: 被古老预言指名的人：出生时有天象（彗星、日食），身上有对应记号。预言给他们方向与追杀者，不直接给力量。

xianxia.concept: 天命之子 / 气运之子（参照）

details.效果: 命运会把机缘推到面前；先知无法看清他们的未来
details.代价: 所有势力都想利用或抹杀

entries.visual: 出生天象的记号（彗星形胎记、日食色的眼睛）。

image.brief: Backdrop: plain dark grey. An adult with ordinary round human ears and clear unscarred skin, a determined, burdened expression, looking slightly upward; on the left cheekbone a sharp-edged dark brown birthmark shaped exactly like a comet: a small round head with one long thin tapering tail sweeping back toward the ear; both eyes have near-black irises each surrounded by a thin, clearly visible bright golden ring at the outer edge like a solar eclipse corona.

subgroups.name: 成长途径
subgroups.intro: 每条途径推动灵魂成色的方式不同，代价和组织归属也不同。一个角色通常有一条主途径；武艺与手艺另按熟练度成长。

entries.name: 拜师学艺
entries.summary: 欧洲最核心的传承方式：学徒跟随大师七年，以服侍换取知识；出师要提交杰作，大师对学徒的过失负连带责任。

xianxia.note: 差异：西方师徒是契约关系（契约书、年限、可买断），不是终身父子名分。

entries.cost: 多年无偿劳动；大师可能藏私或利用学徒。

details.适用: 法师、炼金术士、符文匠、骑士（侍从制）、女巫

entries.visual: 学徒契约书、工坊、师傅的印章。

image.brief: Inside a cluttered wizard's workshop by candlelight, an old master in worn violet robes leans over a young adult apprentice at a long oak workbench, guiding their hand as they copy a glowing diagram of concentric rings into a book, shelves of jars and scrolls behind them.

entries.name: 学院与考核
entries.summary: 系统化学习：入学、讲授、答辩、学位。最昂贵，学院决定谁能接触高阶知识。
entries.cost: 学费与出身门槛；知识被垄断；排名带来的残酷竞争。
entries.visual: 长桌、钟楼、学院袍色区分年级。

references.work: 中世纪大学 / 现代魔法学院题材

image.brief: A great academy disputation hall with tall windows: a young adult scholar in a plain grey gown stands at a lectern defending their thesis, a small original abstract figure of glowing concentric rings and crossing arcs hovering above their open hand (no prisms, no triangles, no rainbow spectrum), while five stern masters in dark robes with silver chains sit behind a long raised table, rows of students watching in the background.

entries.name: 誓言
entries.summary: 以誓言换力量：骑士誓、圣武士誓、守护誓。守誓越久越难，力量越强；背誓则失恩。
entries.cost: 誓言约束一生；背誓失去一切。

details.适用: 骑士、圣武士、狂战士（血誓）

entries.visual: 誓言仪式：剑上起誓、手按圣物。

image.brief: In a torch-lit stone hall a young knight in mail kneels with both hands clasped around the hilt of a sword held point-down, swearing an oath before a standing lord in a fur-lined mantle who rests a hand on the knight's shoulder, a faint warm light beginning to glow around the knight.

entries.name: 禁誓
entries.summary: 凯尔特传统中的个人禁忌：一个人被加上「不得做某事」的禁誓，守住就得到力量或好运，触犯则招来厄运乃至死亡。本库定为可主动承受的力量契约。

xianxia.concept: 禁制 / 誓约神通（参照）

entries.cost: 禁忌往往在最关键的时刻与其他义务冲突。

details.示例结构: 「永不拒绝款待」「日落后不得拔剑」「不得说出自己的名字」

entries.visual: 无外在标志；知情者会利用它设局。

references.note: 库丘林因两个禁誓相冲而死

image.brief: Beneath an ancient oak at dusk, a robed seeress with an iron staff ties a single glowing red thread around the wrist of a kneeling young warrior, binding a vow of taboo; the thread glows and sinks into the skin as a faint mark, wind stirring the leaves.

entries.name: 血脉觉醒
entries.summary: 血里沉睡的祖先之力被唤醒：外形改变、力量骤增。由年龄、危机、月相或接触祖先遗物触发。
entries.cost: 剧痛、外形改变、被同族或猎杀者察觉。

details.适用: 术士、天裔、魔裔、狼人、换生儿

entries.visual: 血管发光、瞳孔变化、角或翼的轮廓浮现。

image.brief: On a rocky hilltop under a huge full moon, a young adult woman on her knees with her head thrown back as her bloodline awakens: her eyes blazing amber-gold, veins along her arms glowing, the shadow cast behind her on the rock shaped like a great wolf.

entries.name: 缔约
entries.summary: 与恶魔、妖精、亡灵君主或古神交易：最快的变强方式，代价写在条款里。
entries.visual: 契约书、契约印记。

image.brief: At a candlelit table in a dark study, a desperate young man dips a quill in his own blood to sign a long glowing parchment, while across the table sits an elegant smiling figure in dark clothes whose face is hidden in shadow except for two ember-orange eyes and the outline of horns.

entries.name: 灵魂缔结
entries.summary: 铜阶起可把灵魂与他者相连：使魔、战马、龙、命定伴侣。双方共享感知与力量，一方受伤另一方同痛。

xianxia.concept: 契约灵兽 / 本命法宝 / 道侣（参照）

entries.cost: 缔结对象死去会重创另一方；不能随意解除。
entries.visual: 两者之间一缕同色的光线；同时眨眼、同时皱眉。

image.brief: A young adult witch sitting by a hearth with a black cat on her lap, both turning their heads at the same moment with the same faint violet glow in their eyes, a thin thread of violet light connecting the woman's chest to the cat.

entries.name: 功业与名声
entries.summary: 西方英雄的核心成长：完成被传颂的功业（屠龙、救城、取回圣物）。名声本身有力量——被越多人传颂，勇武与圣光越强。

xianxia.note: 差异：西方的功业需要「被看见与被讲述」，吟游诗人与歌谣是成长机制的一部分。

entries.cost: 名声可被污损；被遗忘则力量衰减。

details.适用: 骑士、战士、游侠、所有英雄路线

entries.visual: 歌谣、纹章上新增的记号、战利品。

image.brief: A crowded medieval tavern hall at night: a bard stands on a table singing with a lute, the crowd raising mugs, and on the wall behind him painted scenes of a dragon being slain; in a dark corner a scarred warrior listens quietly as a faint warm glow begins around their shoulders.

entries.name: 圣物传承
entries.summary: 被一件古老之物选中：石中剑、先祖的戒指、圣徒的遗骨。器物认主即传下前主的部分力量与记忆。

xianxia.concept: 传承 / 机缘 / 法宝认主（参照）

entries.cost: 器物有自己的意志与前主的执念；被选中就被卷入其宿命。

details.触发: 拔出、触碰、血滴、被器物呼唤

entries.visual: 器物在被选者手中第一次亮起。

image.brief: In a misty forest glade, a young adult in plain peasant clothes closes their hand around the hilt of an ancient sword set in a mossy boulder; the moment their fingers touch it, engraved patterns on the blade flare with golden light and faint ghostly figures of past bearers appear behind them.

entries.name: 炼金蜕变
entries.summary: 饮下嬗变药剂改造身体：获得超常的力量或敏锐，代价是药力催生出「第二个自我」——它在夜里或失控时接管身体。源自十九世纪英国小说中喝药变身的医生原型。

xianxia.concept: 洗髓伐骨 / 禁药（参照）

entries.cost: 第二自我越来越强、越来越难压回去；药剂成瘾。

details.适用: 炼金术士、走投无路的凡人
details.说明: 可选模块；不与猎魔人绑定

entries.visual: 药效发作时骨骼与面容扭曲，眼神换成另一个人。

references.note: 药剂催生的另一个自我

image.brief: In a candlelit alchemist's laboratory, a gentleman scholar grips the edge of a table after drinking from an empty glass, his body mid-transformation and hunching, while in the tall mirror beside him his reflection shows a different, wilder and cruel face.

entries.name: 吞噬
entries.summary: 吃下传说生物的心或血以获得其天赋：北欧英雄尝了龙心之血就听懂鸟语，龙血沐浴得刀枪不入。是一次性的传奇事件，不是可以反复吞服的修炼法；正道视为禁忌。

xianxia.note: 差异：一生一次的传奇事件，获得的是一种具体天赋（鸟语、不坏之身），不是修为。

entries.cost: 获得力量的同时继承被吞者的本性与执念；容易成瘾与腐化。

details.常见对象: 龙心、狼心、恶魔之心、灵魂

entries.visual: 进食之后眼睛与皮肤出现被吞者的特征。

references.note: 西格德尝龙心之血后听懂鸟语

image.brief: At a forest campfire at night a young warrior lifts a fingertip to their lips holding a single drop of glowing golden liquid, the magical blood of a dragon, taken from a small gilded horn cup in their other hand; the birds perched in the branches around them have all turned to look at them, their song visible as faint glowing ripples in the air. No wounds, no organs, no gore; calm and wondrous.

entries.name: 神恩
entries.summary: 力量被直接赐予：天使显现、神迹降临、圣物祝福。无法强求，只能以信、以德、以牺牲回应。

xianxia.concept: 顿悟 / 天降机缘（参照）

entries.cost: 神恩附带使命；拒绝使命即失恩。
entries.visual: 光从高处落下，或梦中受召。

image.brief: In a ruined roofless chapel a ragged pilgrim kneels in the rubble as a column of white-gold light breaks through the clouds onto them alone, faint shapes of great wings in the light above, the pilgrim's face lifted in awe.
